metric_conventions.averaging: macro = unweighted mean over the four classes, so each class counts equally regardless of support
metric_conventions.zero_division_policy: precision, recall, specificity and F1 are defined as 0.0 when their denominator is 0; ROC-AUC and AP return not-available rather than 0 when the class has no positives or no negatives
metric_conventions.specificity: TN / (TN + FP), computed one-vs-rest per class
metric_conventions.brier: multiclass Brier = mean over images of sum_k (p_k - onehot_k)^2
metric_conventions.ece: expected calibration error over 15 equal-width bins on [0,1] applied to the maximum predicted probability
metric_conventions.ece_bin_edges: linspace(0, 1, 16); first bin closed at both ends, rest (lo, hi]
metric_conventions.roc_auc: one-vs-rest, Mann-Whitney rank identity with ties averaged; not-available when undefined
metric_conventions.average_precision: one-vs-rest step-wise average precision (AP): mean of precision at each positive, no interpolation. This is AP, NOT the trapezoidal area under an interpolated precision-recall curve; the two are computed differently and are not interchangeable
metric_conventions.seed_summary: arithmetic mean and sample SD with ddof=1 over 3 seeds

reference_reproduction.macro_f1_evidence_note: No run stores a macro-F1 field. Macro-F1 here is independently recomputed from the prediction CSVs and agrees with the verified summary; this is an independent recomputation, not a stored-metric reproduction.

gate_provenance.argument: src/fusion_v2.py forward() computes cat([c*g_cnn*2, v*g_vit*2]) when gated and cat([c, v]) when not, so the two paths coincide only at a gate mass of exactly 0.5/0.5. The recovered checkpoints load strictly into FusionV2(gated=True, multiscale=True) with 578/578 keys and no missing, unexpected or mis-shaped tensors; their probe gate mass is separated from uniform 0.5/0.5 mixing; and evaluating through that gated path reproduces every one of the 848 recorded reference predictions with no pred_label mismatch. The reference predictions were therefore produced by the gated forward path.
gate_provenance.consequence: The Phase 3A Addendum resolved the reference `gated` setting only from the launch specification, its weakest evidence class. That caveat is SUPERSEDED: the reference is gated on machine-readable, independently checkable evidence.
gate_provenance.what_this_does_not_establish: Gate mass measures branch utilization only. It is not evidence of causal branch contribution, of explanation, or of anatomical attention, and no such claim is made from it.

no_tta_provenance.note: no_tta is an evaluation-only variant: the same verified checkpoint, scored with horizontal-flip TTA disabled. No training occurred and no checkpoint was written.

multiple_comparison_control.family: all 21 seed-specific McNemar tests (7 variants x 3 seeds)
multiple_comparison_control.why_this_family: The primary family is all 21 seed-specific tests. Correcting across 7 while selecting or pooling one p-value per variant would be a smaller, more permissive family reached by discarding evidence, so it is not used. The variant-level view below is descriptive only.
what_is_not_done: the 2,544 predictions are 848 images scored three times and are never pooled as independent observations
no single combined McNemar p-value is manufactured per variant
n=3 seeds is not treated as sufficient for a normal-theory test
nonsignificance is never reported as equivalence

effect_size_threshold_note: No effect-size threshold takes part in any verdict. An earlier version of this analysis used a post-hoc 0.14 pp materiality threshold, defined as twice the reference seed SD; it was chosen after the effect sizes were known, was not an equivalence margin, had no external justification, and has been removed without replacement.

claims: Only removal of the ViT branch produced Holm-significant accuracy losses at all three seeds. Of the 21 seed-specific tests, 4 were significant before Holm correction and 3 after, and every surviving test belongs to `cnn_branch_only`.

Auxiliary-loss removal produced a consistent mean decrease but did not survive Holm correction. The observed accuracy difference was adverse at all three seeds (-0.9434, -0.5896, -0.1179 pp, observed mean -0.5503 pp); the smallest unadjusted p-value was 0.03857 and became 0.6943 after Holm correction across the 21-test family.

The gate showed no detectable accuracy benefit under this protocol. Removing it gave observed accuracy differences of +0.0000, -0.1179, +0.1179 pp (observed mean +0.0000 pp), with 2 and 7 discordant predictions out of 848 at the three seeds, all three Holm-adjusted p-values at 1, and no paired image-level interval excluding zero.

"No detectable accuracy benefit under this protocol" is not equivalence, is not uselessness, and is not proof of zero effect. It means this study - 848 duplicate-clean images, three seeds, a 21-test Holm-corrected family - did not detect a benefit. An effect smaller than this design can resolve would produce exactly the same result.

The gate parameters remain learned and input-dependent. The recovered checkpoints carry a 262914-parameter learned gate module whose output varies across inputs and sums to one per image, with probe CNN gate mass 0.2808, 0.3006, 0.3369 across the three seeds. Whether a component has learned dynamic behaviour and whether removing it changes predictive accuracy are different questions, and only the second is tested here.

All results here are image-level for one duplicate-clean benchmark partition of a single dataset family. They are not patient-level evidence - no patient or study identifiers exist for this split - and they are not clinical evidence.
not_claimed: that only the ViT branch matters: removing the CNN branch (`vit_branch_only`) gave an adverse observed difference at all three seeds, and its verdict is `suggestive but inconclusive`, not an absence of contribution.
that the CNN branch is unnecessary.
that the gate is useless, or that it has zero effect.
that the model should be changed on the strength of this analysis.
any statistical comparison against BRAIN-META: its per-image predictions are unavailable, so no such comparison is computed or implied.

statistical_audit.note: this audit re-reads the prespecified analysis and changes no part of it; the 2,544 predictions are 848 images scored three times and are never treated as independent observations

variant_level_descriptive_note: The variant-level rows summarise three seed-specific comparisons. They are descriptive: no variant-level significance test is computed, because the three seeds share the same 848 images and n=3 cannot support a reliable normal-theory test.

guardrails: external labels were not used for tuning, selection or thresholding
external performance was not used to choose a component
external and clean-test results are never mixed or averaged together

this is external_full: it contains 126 images with a near-duplicate in training and is NOT the separately verified 373-image duplicate-disjoint result, and is not zero-shot duplicate-disjoint performance

limitations: No run stores a macro-F1 value. Every macro-F1 reported here is independently recomputed from the prediction CSVs. This is a recomputation, not a stored-metric reproduction, and is never described as one.
Canonical clean-test membership rests on dataset_clean/split_manifest.json. dataset_clean/Testing holds no images locally, so a directory enumeration cross-check of the 848 identities is unavailable.

The bootstrap resampling unit is an image. No patient or study identifiers exist for this split, so no patient-level or study-level uncertainty is available at any confidence level, and none is claimed.

Seed spread (n=3, ddof=1) and the bootstrap interval measure different things and are reported separately. The seed SD is not a confidence interval and three seeds cannot support a normal-theory test.
A non-significant McNemar result means no detectable difference under this protocol on 848 images. It is not evidence of equivalence, and the component verdicts are worded accordingly.
Gate mass measures branch utilization only. It is not evidence of causal branch contribution, of explanation, or of anatomical attention.

The external 499-image summary is descriptive. It is external_full, which includes 126 images having a near-duplicate in training, and it is neither the verified 373-image duplicate-disjoint result nor a zero-shot generalization measurement.
No comparison against BRAIN-META is computed or implied: its per-image predictions are unavailable, so no statistical statement about it is possible from this repository.
These are in-distribution duplicate-clean test results for one dataset family. They support no claim of clinical readiness, patient-level independence, or generalization across hospitals or scanners.
